instruction: Lift the dark gray cooking kitchenpot using both arms

source.instruction: Lift the dark gray cooking kitchenpot using both arms

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the pot, which was at x = +4 (right half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the pot, which was at x = +4 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 37 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the pot; closed the gripper (opening 0.38: holding the pot); RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 32 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the pot; closed the gripper (opening 0.40: holding the pot)
